Test Case: Click the Finder button in the app toolbar
Expected Result: Studies panel opens; clicking again closes it

Test Case: Toggle the panel then reload the page
Expected Result: Panel open/closed state persists across reload

Test Case: Drag the studies panel resize handle wider and narrower
Expected Result: Panel resizes smoothly and content reflows correctly

Test Case: Resize the panel then reload the page
Expected Result: Panel width persists across reload

Test Case: Type a term in the studies filter/search field
Expected Result: List filters in real time to matching studies and groups

Test Case: Clear the filter field
Expected Result: Full list of studies and groups is restored

Test Case: Enter a filter term with no matches
Expected Result: An appropriate empty state is shown (no errors)

Test Case: Studies menu > New Study
Expected Result: User is taken to the new-study page

Test Case: Create a study with title / subtitle / description and at least one passage
Expected Result: Study is created and appears in the studies panel

Test Case: Attempt to create a study without required fields
Expected Result: Validation prevents creation with a clear message

Test Case: Select a group then Studies menu > New Study in Selected
Expected Result: New study is created inside the selected group

Test Case: Studies menu > New Study Group; create a group with title/subtitle
Expected Result: Group is created and appears in the panel

Test Case: Select a group then Studies menu > New Study Group in Selected
Expected Result: New group is nested inside the selected group

Test Case: Create groups nested several levels deep
Expected Result: Hierarchy displays correctly with expand/collapse working at each level

Test Case: Expand and collapse a study group
Expected Result: Children show/hide correctly; state is remembered as designed

Test Case: Select a study and click Edit in the toolbar
Expected Result: Study edit page opens with existing values populated

Test Case: Change a study's title/subtitle/description and save
Expected Result: Changes are saved and reflected in the panel immediately

Test Case: Select a group and edit its title/subtitle
Expected Result: Changes are saved and reflected in the panel

Test Case: Select a study and use Studies menu > Move to...
Expected Result: Move to Group modal opens; choosing a group moves the study there

Test Case: Move a group into another group via Move to...
Expected Result: Group and all its contents move; nesting displays correctly

Test Case: Select an item inside a group and use Remove from Group
Expected Result: Item moves to the top level of the panel

Test Case: Click a study in the panel
Expected Result: Study becomes selected/highlighted and its view loads

Test Case: Cmd/Ctrl-click multiple studies
Expected Result: Multiple items are selected and shown as selected

Test Case: Shift-click to select a range of items
Expected Result: All items in the range are selected

Test Case: Use arrow keys to move through panel items
Expected Result: Focus moves logically; Enter opens the focused item

Test Case: Select a study and click Delete in the toolbar
Expected Result: Delete confirmation modal appears; confirming deletes the study

Test Case: Cancel the delete confirmation modal
Expected Result: Nothing is deleted and the modal closes

Test Case: Delete a group that contains studies
Expected Result: Confirmation warns about contents, and deletion cascades correctly

Test Case: Multi-select several items and delete
Expected Result: All selected items are deleted after a single confirmation

Test Case: Drag a study to a new position in the list
Expected Result: Drop indicator shows during drag; order updates and persists

Test Case: Drag a study into a group
Expected Result: Study becomes a child of the group

Test Case: Start a drag then press Escape or drop in an invalid spot
Expected Result: Drag cancels cleanly with no change to the list

Test Case: With nothing selected verify Edit and Delete toolbar buttons
Expected Result: Both buttons are disabled

Test Case: Select a study then sign out and back in
Expected Result: Panel restores correctly and the last study view opens as designed
